rules.statement: The Court held that the execution of deed P2 has not been duly proved, as it was not produced in proper custody and only a certified copy was examined.
rules.supporting_quote: "Perhaps he had section 90 of the Evidence Ordinance in mind when he made the statement above quoted , but he does not appear to have considered the terms of that section as carefully as he should have. That section reads- 'Where any document purporting or proved to be thirty years old is produced from any custody which the court in the particular case considers proper, the court may presume that the signature and every other part of such document which purports to be in the handwriting of any particular person is in that person's handwriting, and, in the case of a document executed or attested, that it was duly executed and attested by the persons by whom it purports to be executed and attested.'"
